summary: Victim observed a wallet application impersonating the Trezor brand that displayed a USDT balance but required a substantial BNB payment before funds could be transferred. Community analysis indicated the platform was unaffiliated with Trezor and used fake balances to solicit additional deposits.
user_mistake: Believed a displayed wallet balance without independently verifying the wallet provider
prevention: Confirm wallet providers through official vendor websites / Refuse payments required to unlock displayed balances
